<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915661_theRebbe_783" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915661_theRebbe_783__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that in the future, through the drawing down of the innerness of Atik, the revelation will reach even the lowest sparks and physicality, unlike in the days of Shlomo.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And it is explained in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="3">that through that in the future to come the drawing down will be from the innerness of Atik</t>
    <t s="4">(the Ein Sof that is in Arich Anpin)</t>
    <t s="5">which is above the drawing down that was in the days of Shlomo,</t>
    <t s="6">through this the revelation will be drawn down lower.</t>
    <t s="7">And as it is brought in Etz Chaim60,</t>
    <t s="8">that in the ascent of Malchus there are seven levels.</t>
    <t s="9">In the days of Shlomo there was the sixth level and in the future there will be the seventh level.</t>
    <t s="10">And among the differences between them is,</t>
    <t s="11">that in the sixth level,</t>
    <t s="12">the revelation in Malchus is only in the nine Sefiros within it and up to the aspect of Yesod within it</t>
    <t s="13">(and the revelation in Malchus of Malchus61</t>
    <t s="14">was through its being included in its Yesod),</t>
    <t s="15">and in the seventh level,</t>
    <t s="16">the revelation is also in Malchus of Malchus</t>
    <t s="17">(as it is in its place).</t>
    <t s="18">And he continues in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="19">that the difference between the two ascents of Malchus</t>
    <t s="20">(the sixth ascent in the days of Shlomo and the seventh ascent that will be in the future)</t>
    <t s="21">is also regarding the sparks that fell below.</t>
    <t s="22">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="23">that Yesod of Nukva is the connection of the recipient</t>
    <t s="24">(Malchus)</t>
    <t s="25">with the influencer</t>
    <t s="26">(Zeir Anpin),</t>
    <t s="27">and Malchus of Malchus is</t>
    <t s="28">(generally speaking)</t>
    <t s="29">the power of the actor within the acted-upon.</t>
    <t s="30">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="31">in the days of Shlomo when the revelation in Malchus was only at the level of Malchus as it relates to Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="32">the elevation of the sparks that fell below was only of those sparks that are capable of feeling G-dly light62.</t>
    <t s="33">And in the future when the revelation will also be at the level of Malchus as it is in Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, even to the power of the actor within the acted-upon,</t>
    <t s="34">even the sparks that have distanced themselves from Malchus, which therefore are not capable</t>
    <t s="35">(from their own perspective)</t>
    <t s="36">of feeling G-dly light,</t>
    <t s="37">and even the sparks that have distanced themselves so much that they themselves have become like evil,</t>
    <t s="38">they too will be elevated and included in holiness.</t>
    <t s="39">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="40">that even the physical itself</t>
    <t s="41">(not only the spark within it)</t>
    <t s="42">will be in ultimate unity with G-dliness.</t>
    <t s="43">And that the physical will then be in ultimate unity is not only because then the G-dly power within it that brings it into existence from nothing will be revealed,</t>
    <t s="44">the revelation of the power of the actor within the acted-upon,</t>
    <t s="45">but rather that even the acted-upon itself will be in ultimate unity.</t>
    <t s="46">And the reason for all this is</t>
    <t s="47">(as brought above from the maamar),</t>
    <t s="48">because then there will be the drawing down of the innerness of Atik</t>
    <t s="49">(the Ein Sof that is in Arich Anpin),</t>
    <t s="50">and therefore there will then be revelation even in Malchus of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="51">and moreover – even below in this physical world,</t>
    <t s="52">in the holy sparks within physical things</t>
    <t s="53">(even in the sparks that have distanced themselves),</t>
    <t s="54">and even in the physical things themselves.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the reason the drawing down of the innerness of Atik reveals G-dliness everywhere is because it is the Essence of the Ein Sof, for which no existence is separate.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the reason for this, that through the drawing down of the innerness of Atik</t>
    <t s="2">(the Ein Sof that is in Arich Anpin)</t>
    <t s="3">there will be a revelation of G-dliness in every place,</t>
    <t s="4">is,</t>
    <t s="5">because the innerness of Atik is</t>
    <t s="6">(in general)</t>
    <t s="7">the Essence of the Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="8">for regarding the Essence of the Ein Sof there is no existence separate from Him,</t>
    <t s="9">and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="10">the true reality of His existence is the existence of all existences63,</t>
    <t s="11">and therefore through the revelation of the innerness of Atik,</t>
    <t s="12">it will be felt in every thing that its existence is G-dliness.</t>
    <t s="13">And based on this it can be said that the elevation in the world that will come through the drawing down of the innerness of Atik relative to the state of the world in the days of Shlomo is also regarding those things in which there was already a revelation of G-dliness in the days of Shlomo.</t>
    <t s="14">For the revelation that was in the days of Shlomo</t>
    <t s="15">(when the revelation then was from the externality of Atik)</t>
    <t s="16">was like an additional thing upon the things in which the revelation was drawn,</t>
    <t s="17">and the revelation that will be in the future in every thing is that their very existence will be revealed.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the drawing down of the innerness of Atik is specifically through the "chassidim," whose self-nullification and service for the sake of Heaven enables a revelation from the Essence itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">B)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is "and Your chassidim will bless You,"</t>
    <t s="3">that the drawing down into Malchus</t>
    <t s="4">("yevarchu chah")</t>
    <t s="5">that is drawn down through Your chassidim is in a manner of Chesed,</t>
    <t s="6">an overflowing of good.</t>
    <t s="7">For in addition to that they draw down into Malchus the lights that had departed from it, through which its lack is filled,</t>
    <t s="8">they draw down into it the matter of wealth that is above filling a lack,</t>
    <t s="9">Atik,</t>
    <t s="10">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="11">that they draw down into it also the revelation that is above the aspect of wealth,</t>
    <t s="12">the innerness of Atik.</t>
    <t s="13">And it is explained in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="14">that this, that this drawing down is drawn down through Your chassidim</t>
    <t s="15">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="16">is due to two matters.</t>
    <t s="17">Due to their self-nullification.</t>
    <t s="18">As the statement of the Zohar</t>
    <t s="19">(brought above in section 5)</t>
    <t s="20">"Who is a chassid who acts piously with his Master,"</t>
    <t s="21">that his service is not for himself in order that he should be attached to G-dliness but rather for the sake of the Above,</t>
    <t s="22">as explained in Tanya64.</t>
    <t s="23">And through that their service is in self-nullification</t>
    <t s="24">(above existence),</t>
    <t s="25">therefore the drawing down that is drawn through their service is from the aspect of the Essence that is above diffusion</t>
    <t s="26">(existence),</t>
    <t s="27">Atik,</t>
    <t s="28">and moreover – the innerness of Atik.</t>
    <t s="29">[And this is "Who is a chassid who acts piously with his Master" and it is explained in Tikkunei Zohar "with His nest."</t>
    <t s="30">For from the explanations regarding the connection of these two matters is,</t>
    <t s="31">that through his acting piously with his Master,</t>
    <t s="32">that his service is not for himself but for the sake of the Above,</t>
    <t s="33">therefore he has the power to act piously with His nest,</t>
    <t s="34">that the drawing down into Malchus</t>
    <t s="35">(His nest)</t>
    <t s="36">will be</t>
    <t s="37">(not only in a manner of tzedakah,</t>
    <t s="38">filling a lack,</t>
    <t s="39">but rather)</t>
    <t s="40">in a manner of Chesed – wealth and above wealth].</t>
    <t s="41">And another matter regarding the connection of the drawing down of the innerness of Atik to Your chassidim,</t>
    <t s="42">that the matter of Chassidus is that natural powers become G-dly powers65,</t>
    <t s="43">and the innovation in the world that will be in the future through the drawing down of the innerness of Atik is "then I will transform the peoples to a pure language"66</t>
    <t s="44">[that the refinement in the days of Shlomo was through that the light from above drew to itself the sparks within the nations</t>
    <t s="45">(as above),</t>
    <t s="46">and in the future they themselves will be transformed into holiness],</t>
    <t s="47">in the manner that natural powers are transformed and become G-dly powers.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
